shadeMap.title: Shade Map
shadeMap.description: Explore Trece Martires in 3D with estimated building and tree-canopy shadows.
shadeMap.boundaryNote: The OpenStreetMap outline and streets are community-mapped, not City-approved. Routes are kept inside this displayed outline, which may differ from the legal city boundary.
shadeMap.coverage: Building footprints and estimated heights use Google's 2023 Open Buildings dataset at about 4 m effective resolution. Height accuracy was evaluated in North America, Europe, and Japan, not the Philippines; footprints may be shifted or missed. These are modeled estimates, not local survey heights. Clouds and actual temperature are not modeled.
shadeMap.buildingData: Open Buildings estimates are attributed to Google Research. OSM building heights are used only if that layer cannot load.
shadeMap.buildingUnavailable: The 2023 building-height layer could not be loaded; height coverage may be limited.
shadeMap.canopyData: Tree canopy patches use Meta/WRI CHMv2 imagery dated 2010, 2014, and 2018, aggregated to about 6 m. They are not individual-tree surveys.
shadeMap.canopyUnavailable: Tree-canopy data could not be loaded.
shadeMap.routeNote: Search mapped places across Trece Martires or set A and B on the full-screen map. Routes use the local citywide OpenStreetMap street and path snapshot.
shadeMap.searchPlaceholder: Search cafes, malls, resorts, gyms, shops & more
shadeMap.noLocalResults: No matching place in the mapped city list. Try another name or category.
shadeMap.placeSource: {{count}} mapped places from OpenStreetMap · snapshot {{date}}. Some businesses may be missing or outdated.
shadeMap.orTapMap: Or choose a point on the map
shadeMap.mapClickHint: Choose A or B, then tap the map
shadeMap.outsideBoundary: Choose a point inside the displayed Trece Martires outline.
shadeMap.locationUnavailable: Your location could not be read. Check location permission and try again.
shadeMap.routePrompt: Search for a place anywhere in Trece Martires or tap inside the outline to choose a point.
shadeMap.shadePreferenceNote: Choose More shade to prefer modeled shade; it may take longer. The shade estimate is not a safety guarantee.
shadeMap.noExtraShade: No additional mapped shade is estimated for these routes at the selected time.
shadeMap.sameRouteNoSun: The sun is below the horizon, so both choices use the same shortest route. Preview a daytime hour to compare estimated shade.
shadeMap.noRoute: No connected mapped route was found. Try points closer to a mapped street or path.
shadeMap.routeDisclaimer: Shortest connected route through mapped OSM streets and paths in Trece Martires. Sidewalks, access tags, and closures may be missing. Shade uses modeled 2023 building heights and 2010–2018 canopy imagery for the selected time. It is an estimate, not a safety guarantee.
shadeMap.mapError: The map could not be loaded. Check your connection and try again.
shadeMap.mapLabel: Interactive 3D shade map of Trece Martires
shadeMap.sunBelowHorizon: Sun is below the horizon; no sun-cast shadow is shown.
